physicalNotes: No radius or mass of the Galactic Centre is recorded: its package shows extended gas, and its package frames it at 2.006 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), the circle its picture is drawn in, a presentation value.

sources.position: Sagittarius A*'s place, the focus of the streams' orbits: SIMBAD NAME Sgr A* (ICRS; coordinate reference 2011AJ....142...35P, Petrov et al. 2011, VLBA): https://simbad.cds.unistra.fr/simbad/sim-id?Ident=Sgr+A*
sources.distance: GRAVITY Collaboration (2022, A&A 657, L12; arXiv:2112.07478), Table 1, four-star fit: R0 = 8277 +/- 9 pc.
sources.properMotion: Sagittarius A*'s, so the streams stay about the black hole: Reid & Brunthaler (2020, ApJ 892, 39; arXiv:2001.04386): -6.411 +/- 0.008 mas/yr along the Galactic plane and -0.219 +/- 0.007 mas/yr toward the North Galactic Pole, converted to ICRS components with Astropy 8.0.1 at the SIMBAD position: -3.1528, -5.5865 mas/yr (their Table 2 row against J1745-2820 reads -3.147, -5.578).
sources.radialVelocity: Sagittarius A*'s: GRAVITY Collaboration (2022), Table 1: vz0 = -1.8 +/- 1.3 km/s, the fitted line-of-sight velocity of the mass centre.
